# Provenance

This is a purpose-built bounded v0.10 validation task, not evidence for the real-task gate. The instruction itself fixes both Boolean inputs and all four concrete pairs. `repository/` is the exact base tree; `patches/public.patch`, `patches/hidden.patch`, and `patches/solution.patch` reconstruct the three frozen workspace states. `artifacts/` contains byte-exact final reference and verifier sources used for independent translation.
